unresolved.detail: 4 cells total, 2 distinct bookings: p03 (1st Yr ECE-A) and p04 (1st Yr ECE-B), both 'EF-1 [ANK] (G01)', Tue 4-5 PM + 5-6 PM. G01 appears nowhere else in new tt.pdf, not in old-tt.pdf, not in any glossary, legend or footnote, and nowhere in the repository. The source never expands it.

6 cells on p03 (Dr. Ankit) and p04 (Dr. Ankita), identical scheduling (Tue 4-5/5-6 PM in G01; Sat 1-2 PM and 2-3/3-4 PM in 214). One person clubbed across ECE-A and ECE-B; which spelling is correct cannot be determined from the source. ANK is absent from faculty.csv and from old-tt.pdf.

3 cells. p03 (1st Yr ECE-A) glossary says VA = Dr. Vandana Kumari; p02, p04, faculty.csv and the old timetable all say VA = Dr. Vijay Azad. The p03 cell (HBT, Wed 4-5/5-6 PM, room 213) uses VA, so p03 is internally consistent but contradicts five other sources. Not resolvable from the source.

3 cells on p12 (2nd Yr CSE-B) write the cohort tag without a space: 'DBMS (P) CSE-B2 [GB] (R3)', 'ADA (P) CSE-B2 [GB] (R3)', 'ADA (P) CSE-B1 [JJ] (513)'. Every other cell in the document writes 'CSE-B B2'. Read as section CSE-B + batch B2/B1.
